# Complaint triage taxonomy for the Bank.
# Each complaint receives exactly one product and one issue from this file.

version: 3
products:
  - product: Checking/Savings
    issues:
      - Account opening or closing
      - Deposits and withdrawals
      - Overdraft or NSF fees
      - Transfers and automatic payments
      - Account access or frozen funds

  - product: Credit card
    issues:
      - Billing dispute
      - Unauthorized charge
      - Fees or interest
      - Credit limit change
      - Rewards

  - product: Mortgage
    issues:
      - Payment processing or escrow
      - Late fees
      - Loan modification or forbearance
      - Servicing transfer
      - Closing costs

  - product: Auto loan
    issues:
      - Payment problem
      - Repossession
      - Add-on products or GAP coverage
      - Payoff or title release

  - product: Personal loan
    issues:
      - Application or denial
      - Payment problem
      - Fees or interest
      - Payoff

  - product: Debt collection
    issues:
      - Debt not owed
      - Communication tactics
      - Validation or verification
      - Credit reporting of collected debt

  - product: Other/escalate
    issues:
      - Needs human review

complaint_id,date_received,channel,narrative
C-0801,2026-09-21,Web,"I split a $1,240 laptop into 6 monthly payments using the Bank's pay later option at checkout. The screen said no credit check, not a loan. Payments are supposed to come out on the 10th. In September they took $206.67 on the 10th AND again on the 24th. When I called they said the plan reset after a system update. I can't afford to pay double, please refund the extra one."
C-0802,2026-09-21,Phone,"There is a $49.99 charge every month on my card from a streaming service I never signed up for, going back to May. That's 5 charges. I never gave anyone my card number. The Bank only refunded the most recent one and said the rest are past the dispute window."
C-0803,2026-09-22,Mail,The Bank closed my checking account with no warning and mailed me a check for my balance. The letter just says it was a business decision. I have banked there 14 years. My paycheck direct deposit bounced and my car insurance payment got returned. I deserve an explanation.
C-0804,2026-09-23,Web,"Applied for a $15,000 personal loan for home repairs and got denied for insufficient income. My income is $84,000 and I entered it correctly. When I called they said the system read it as $8,400. Their fix is that I reapply, which means another hard inquiry on my credit."
C-0805,2026-09-24,Email,Three months in a row I've been charged a $64 late fee on my mortgage. My payment posts on the 14th every month and my grace period runs through the 15th. I have asked twice to have the fees reversed and nothing has happened.
Five complaints. C-0801 is a pay-later installment plan at checkout, so I'm labeling it as that so it routes to the team that owns installments.
